role: Root onboarding container: a 7-page paged TabView (Welcome, ValueProp, Profile, Sensor, Apple Health, Backup, Done) shown by EmuquApp's launch modal (.onboarding) before onboarding is complete; the Done page writes the onboarding-complete settings flags and kicks a CloudKit full sync. Also declares OnboardingFillingScroll, a fill-or-scroll page wrapper used by the Welcome, ValueProp, Backup and Done pages and by TrialReminderView and PreScorePromptView.
types: OnboardingView: struct — paged onboarding container; owns currentPage and completion
OnboardingFillingScroll<Content>: struct — GeometryReader+ScrollView wrapper that fills the screen height and scrolls when content is taller
state: @State healthPageAnswered (Bool, false) — set when the Health page itself advanced (Skip or Continue), so that move is not read as a swipe-past
toplevel: pageCount literal 7 must match the seven tags 0-6 in `pages` (OnboardingView.swift:30, 52-65). #Preview builds OnboardingView with AppDependencies.current settingsManager and a fresh RRCollector (lines 239-243).

units.entry: Called by EmuquApp.swift:348 `OnboardingView(onTakeReading: { requestedTab = .record })`, by #Preview and by EmuquTests/PageSnapshotTests.swift:47.

units.does: Draws AppTheme.background under a page-style TabView bound to currentPage with always-visible index dots, animating page changes; on every page change calls noteHealthPageSwipedPast(from:to:).
units.entry: SwiftUI body; .onChange(of: currentPage) fires on swipe or programmatic page change.

units.does: Builds the seven tagged pages: Welcome(0), ValueProp(1), Profile(2), Sensor(3) each advancing via advanceToNext; Health(4) advancing via advanceFromHealthPage; Backup(5) via advanceToNext; donePage(6).
units.entry: SwiftUI ViewBuilder content of the TabView in body.

units.does: When the page changes from the Apple Health page (4) to a later page by a swipe — the page's own Skip/Continue did not answer it (healthPageAnswered false) — and HealthKitManager.authorizationRequested is false in this process, asks HealthKit in a Task whether the permission sheet was already answered in any launch (authorizationWasEverRequested); only when it was not, sets UserDefaults healthAccessSkippedInOnboarding = true (treats a swipe-past as "Skip for now").

branches.effect: continues to the HealthKit check; else returns without writing

branches.cond: authorizationWasEverRequested true (answered in an earlier launch)
branches.effect: returns without writing; else writes healthAccessSkipped=true

units.does: Advance handler for the Health page (Skip, or Continue after Connect): marks healthPageAnswered, then advanceToNext, so the page-change observer does not record this advance as a swipe-past skip.
units.entry: closure passed to OnboardingHealthPage(advance:) at line 60; invoked by that page's Continue / Skip for now buttons.

units.does: Animates currentPage to currentPage+1, clamped to pageCount-1 (6).
units.entry: Passed as the advance closure to the Welcome/ValueProp/Profile/Sensor/Backup pages (lines 52-62).

units.does: Marks onboarding finished: sets settings.hasCompletedOnboarding, hasAcknowledgedScoreArchitectureChange and hasRunScoreHistoryRecompute to true (three separate SettingsManager.settings writes, each saved and posting flowRecoverySettingsChanged from the didSet unless the settings load was blocked by data protection), then, if iCloud sync is enabled, launches a Task running CloudKitSyncManager.performFullSyncIfNeeded(minInterval: 0). The hasCompletedOnboarding change fires EmuquApp.handleOnboardingCompletion (EmuquApp.swift:397-398, 421-428), which shows the paywall when StoreKitManager.paywallEnabled and the user has no active access, otherwise dismisses the onboarding modal.

branches.effect: true: fires an unstructured Task awaiting cloudSyncManager.performFullSyncIfNeeded(minInterval: 0), so the full sync runs regardless of last sync time. false: no sync.
